title: Why Sounds Change When Your Eyes Are Closed
hook: Close your eyes, and sounds around you will change.

narration.text: Close your eyes right now and listen.
Sounds suddenly seem louder, or closer.
This happens because your brain reallocates resources.
When vision is removed, other senses are heightened.
Your brain uses more processing power on hearing.
It is a survival mechanism, helping you detect threats.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more mind-bending facts.

description: Have you ever noticed that sounds seem different when your eyes are closed? This short explains the fascinating reason behind this common phenomenon, revealing how your brain adapts.
topic: Why you hear different sounds when you close your eyes compared to when they are open. You can test this right now, just close your eyes.
